description: A browser-facing API in a single settings module, which is the shape most Django projects have and the one the split-settings pair does not cover: a rule that quietly assumes there is a base module to inherit from shows up here. Everything is deliberately configured correctly except one pairing. CORS is opened to every origin while credentials are allowed, and django-cors-headers responds by dropping the wildcard and reflecting the caller's own origin with Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true -- so DJS-016 reports it as critical, and DJS-015 must stay silent, because the two rules carry inverse preconditions and one open CORS policy is one defect. SECURE_PROXY_SSL_HEADER is set correctly and is still reported at low/tentative: that is DJS-012's informational branch, which nothing else exercises, and it is here so that a change to it is a visible change.
